title: Between Stillness and Light
statement:
Description

Between Stillness and Light exists across print and motion, allowing the same emotional state to unfold through different forms of presence. The video unfolds as a suspended emotional field — a moment where motion slows and perception sharpens. Forms emerge and dissolve gently, never fully resolving, allowing the viewer’s own inner state to complete the experience.
